desc:
Welcome to Bees 🐝

Jump into Bees, a fun and exciting catching adventure where luck is everything! 🎯
Catch rare and powerful bees 🐝 ✨, explore unique biomes 🌳🌸, and travel across the map, even to a HUGE volcano 🌋🔥!

Every bee is RNG-based 🎲, so you never know what you’ll catch next… 👀

⏰ Weekly updates, so stay tuned! 🚀
